Tom Brennan Memorial 5K 2027

Friday, 1 January 2027 at 9:30 AM - Phoenix Park


Full race information

Entries are now open for this fast, flat, PB-friendly 5K. All finishers receive a bespoke bobble hat. The race celebrates our legendary clubmate Tom Brennan's 1975 National Cross Country Championship triumph.

Inspired by the incredible achievements of our Irish Olympic heroes?

Liffey Valley AC seek Women and Men Runners who want to improve and compete. Expert Coaches Plan Training To Help You Race To Your Full Potential

Why Not Come Along Tues and Thurs?
